title: Solid button :active must differ from :hover color
answers: Why does clicking a solid button in the new theme look the same as hovering it?
Solid button has no pressed/active visual feedback
How should active vs hover background be chosen for solid buttons?
body: Symptom: in the visual-refresh theme, clicking a solid-fill button (primary/secondary/etc.) gave no visible feedback distinct from the hover state. Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Button/Button.tsx:getActiveButtonStyles and getButtonVariantStyles used the same emphasis token (color.mainEmphasis/backgroundEmphasis) for both hover and active. Fix pattern: for visualRefreshEnabled solid fills, hover uses color.backgroundEmphasis while active uses the base color.background, so the two states are visually distinct; outline/transparent fills instead use color.subtleBackground on hover and aren't affected. Constraints: applies only when fill === 'solid' and theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh is true; the 'secondary' solid button is the sole exception that also sets its border to color.subtleBorder (normal) / color.border (hover) since it's the only solid variant with a visible border.
applies: grafana-ui Button component, visual-refresh theme, solid-fill variants

Applies to solid-fill buttons (primary, secondary, etc.) via getActiveButtonStyles and getButtonVariantStyles in packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Button/Button.tsx when fill === 'solid' and theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh is true. Hover uses color.backgroundEmphasis, active uses color.background for visual distinction; secondary variant is the sole exception with color.subtleBorder (normal) / color.border (hover) for its border. Guidance applies when fixing visual feedback on button click interactions in visual-refresh theme.
